description: GET ONLY the 'EarlyAccess' field of TitlePublicConfigurationModel. EarlyAccess - early token purchase: while the game's token is on its bonding curve and its early phase is open, only players holding a pass may buy it. The phase itself (duration up to 7 days, total cap, no-sell) is fixed when the token is launched, allowed by the platform per title or publisher, and frozen on chain - this section cannot change it. Enabled is the master switch (default OFF). Tiers: each has TierID, MaxQuote (how much of the chain's quote token in wei the player's wallet may spend in the phase in total), NotBeforeUtc (the wave; empty = at once) and Conditions, ALL of which must hold: QuestCompleted {QuestID} (hours played, logins, kills and any metric are quests), ItemOwned {ItemID, MinAmount default 1, MinLevel}, LeaderboardRank {LeaderboardID, MaxRank}, CloudCodeGrant {GrantID, given by a script with server.GrantEarlyAccess}, Segment {Gate}. Empty Conditions = any player with a verified wallet. A player gets the best tier (higher MaxQuote, then the earlier wave); OR = several tiers. The player requests the pass himself (EarlyAccess.GetPass); it is personal, bound to one wallet, never published.
name: get_early_access
title: Get Early Access settings
